<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the molecular formula C10H13 (no N or halogens), DBE = (2*10 + 2 - 13)/2 = 9/2 = 4.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the correct integer value is 5 (rounding up to the nearest whole number).</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
